scope: Project-owned runtime configuration and deliberate environment reads reachable through the currently wired pgx, AWS default config/KMS credential chain, Google ADC and Azure DefaultAzureCredential, plus Go transport/trust/home/executable lookup inputs. Source-only review at the pinned dependencies.
limits: Hashes record reviewed source bytes. Unit checks pin dependency versions and schema source coverage, require all eight Go boundaries for every declared minimum/current version, and compare the running toolchain source bytes without fetching SDK source or invoking native loaders.
Broader unused SDK APIs, general Go runtime knobs and arbitrary external credential-tool environments are outside the scalar parser. Their resolution must remain explicitly owned.
No credential files, environment values, provider commands or external endpoints were read to produce this inventory.

Windows lookup reads PATHEXT, presence of NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath and case-insensitive path. Suffix normalization, absent/empty defaults and separators-only behavior are unchanged; source bytes are identical across the declared versions.

UserHomeDir reads HOME on Unix and USERPROFILE on Windows. Its scoped implementation is unchanged across the declared versions; other OS defaults remain native and are not additional supported server platforms.
splitList preserves colon-separated empty entries and literal quotes; empty input yields an empty list. The bounded project projection preserves this grammar before native resolution.

splitList respects quotes while splitting semicolon-separated paths, then removes quotes, including unmatched quotes. Empty input yields an empty list; project item/count bounds apply before decoding. Source review is not native Windows runtime evidence.

FromEnvironment chooses HTTP_PROXY before http_proxy, HTTPS_PROXY before https_proxy and NO_PROXY before no_proxy. REQUEST_METHOD enables CGI restrictions. Only comments change across the declared versions; do not substitute the separately pinned x/net lowercase-first helper.

loadSystemRoots moved to root.go. SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR can select on-disk roots on Windows, Darwin and iOS as well as Unix. On those platform-verifier systems no override retains systemPool; GODEBUG=x509sslcertoverrideplatform=0 also retains it. loadOnDiskRoots uses filepath.SplitList, reads files/directories and skips same-directory symlinks. Native global initialization and GODEBUG retain their own owner; input capture does not freeze or invoke them. The internal Go compatibility table marks x509sslcertoverrideplatform Changed27 Old0: the retained module Go1.26.9 minimum keeps platform roots by default even with compiler1.27.2; native GODEBUG can explicitly opt in.

Validated support-policy queries own target and command argv lists. Normal packaging requires the declared current compiler and the existing clean-tree, live-dependency, production-check and signing preflight. Only Linux/amd64 includes server commands; other declared targets build the CLI. Read-only --plan avoids Git/Go/Make/provider/signing work. Archive arrays replace wildcard selection; the pre-build manifest commits the policy digest. No external publication or native-platform qualification is implied.
